meta.description: Generates 3D conformer ensembles using RDKit ETKDGv3, checked MMFF94s/UFF optimization, macrocycle-aware settings, and an optional CREST plus GFN2-xTB escalation path. Use for 3D ligand preparation, docking inputs, conformer-sensitive descriptors, and macrocycle ensemble diagnostics.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All reported geometric and energy values were produced by RDKit or xTB during this audit. The macrocycle comparison now limits its conclusion to molecule-specific evidence and does not claim universal superiority.

practice_boundaries.detail: This is a computational molecular-geometry workflow with no diagnostic, prescriptive, or patient-facing use.

methodological_ground.detail: The Skill requires downstream convergence and chemistry-appropriate validation rather than treating isolated force-field minima or one macrocycle setting as definitive.

code_usability.detail: Every Python fence compiled; nine archived logical workflows and two fresh packaged-example/edge workflows executed against the exact source commit (11/11).

functional_suitability.note: The documented ETKDGv3, MMFF94s/UFF, macrocycle, CREST boundary, and Boltzmann workflows are present and were exercised on realistic molecules.

reliability.note: All public entry points now reject zero-atom SMILES explicitly; empty and mismatched helper inputs have deterministic, documented behavior.

performance_context.note: The Skill identifies scalable starting heuristics and bounded filtering, though high conformer counts remain molecule- and hardware-dependent by design.

agent_usability.note: Decision rules, error modes, platform caveat, and the mapping to packaged example names are explicit; the broad method taxonomy still requires a selection judgment.

human_usability.note: The trigger description, scenario table, usage guide, and error table give a researcher clear entry points and recovery actions.

security.note: SMILES and numeric inputs are validated, subprocess invocation uses an argument list rather than a shell, and no credentials or sensitive data are handled.

maintainability.note: The runnable packaged examples now have consistent contracts, and the macrocycle diagnostic is isolated in its own documented script.

agent_specific.note: The Skill is precisely triggered and has explicit hand-offs and platform escape hatches. It remains a substantial but still under-500-line technical Skill.

inputs.label: Aspirin ETKDGv3 plus MMFF94s ensemble regression
inputs.execution_note: Embedded and optimized 20/20 requested aspirin conformers from the exact inline code.
inputs.note: 20 conformers converged; energies were 18.9098 to 20.8331 kcal/mol.

assertions.text: The requested 20 conformers are embedded.
assertions.note: EmbedMultipleConfs returned 20 IDs.

assertions.text: Each conformer has a converged MMFF94s optimization and real energy.
assertions.note: 20/20 optimization records converged with finite calculated energies.

assertions.text: The result is deterministic for the documented seed.
assertions.note: The fixed-seed regression values match the archived run.

assertions.text: No global-minimum claim is inferred from the sampled ensemble.
assertions.note: The workflow reports sampled local-minimum energies only.

inputs.label: Ibuprofen single docking conformer and SDF regression
inputs.execution_note: Generated one seeded conformer, optimized it, wrote SDF, and round-tripped it.
inputs.note: The SDF contains non-planar coordinates and an MMFF94s energy of 25.2875 kcal/mol.

assertions.text: A single conformer is embedded and optimized for the documented docking-start use case.
assertions.note: One conformer and one MMFF94s result were returned.

assertions.text: The written SDF is parseable and genuinely three-dimensional.
assertions.note: Round-trip SDF had a coordinate Z range greater than 0.1 angstrom.

assertions.text: The reported energy is computed rather than a placeholder.
assertions.note: Energy came from RDKit force-field CalcEnergy.

assertions.text: The workflow stays within ligand-preparation scope.
assertions.note: No docking score or binding claim was made.

inputs.label: Phenylboronic acid MMFF gap and UFF fallback regression
inputs.execution_note: Ran the exact inline optimization workflow on boron-containing phenylboronic acid.
inputs.note: 10/10 conformers embedded and used UFF; energies were 11.4524 to 11.4747 kcal/mol.

assertions.text: MMFF94s unavailability triggers the documented UFF fallback.
assertions.note: All result records named UFF.

assertions.text: The fallback produces one finite energy per conformer.
assertions.note: 10 UFF energy records were produced.

assertions.text: The fallback is explicit rather than a silent no-op.
assertions.note: Force-field selection is recorded in each output row.

assertions.text: Unsupported chemistry has an actionable terminal error path.
assertions.note: The inline code raises if neither MMFF94s nor UFF has parameters.

inputs.label: Fourteen-membered macrocycle ETKDGv3 regression
inputs.execution_note: Ran macrocycle_conformers on a verified 14-membered ring with a bounded 10-conformer fixture under current RDKit.
inputs.note: 10/10 embedded with finite MMFF94s energies; current ETKDGv3 default reports useMacrocycleTorsions=True.

assertions.text: The fixture is a macrocycle under the Skill's stated threshold.
assertions.note: RDKit ring analysis returned one 14-atom ring.

assertions.text: The macrocycle-aware embedding path returns the requested conformers.
assertions.note: 10/10 conformers embedded.

assertions.text: The documented current RDKit default is verified rather than assumed.
assertions.note: ETKDGv3().useMacrocycleTorsions was True in RDKit 2026.03.6.

assertions.text: The Skill does not claim a universal macrocycle benefit from this setting.
assertions.note: The revised text requires molecule-specific comparison and downstream validation.

inputs.label: Flexible imatinib full pipeline regression
inputs.execution_note: Ran embed, optimize, RMSD prune, energy filter, and Boltzmann averaging using the documented 5 times rotatable bonds plus 10 heuristic.
inputs.note: 7 rotatable bonds yielded 45 requested and embedded conformers; 43 survived pruning and 38 the energy window.

assertions.text: The documented conformer-count heuristic is computed correctly.
assertions.note: 7 rotatable bonds gave max(10, 5*7+10) = 45.

assertions.text: The full workflow completes with finite intermediate and final outputs.
assertions.note: All five stages completed and Boltzmann asphericity was 0.43156.

assertions.text: RMSD and energy filtering preserve a nonempty ensemble.
assertions.note: 43 then 38 conformers remained.

assertions.text: Boltzmann averaging is used as an exploratory surrogate, not a validated population claim.
assertions.note: The Skill states the required thermodynamic caveat.

inputs.label: Native-Windows CREST boundary and xTB fallback regression
inputs.execution_note: Executed crest_workflow without CREST and then the documented standalone xTB fallback.
inputs.note: CREST gave expected WinError 2; xTB returned 0 and wrote parseable xtbopt.xyz.

assertions.text: The native-Windows CREST caveat predicts the observed failure mode.
assertions.note: crest_workflow raised FileNotFoundError / WinError 2.

assertions.text: The documented standalone xTB fallback actually executes.
assertions.note: xTB --opt returned 0 and wrote xtbopt.xyz.

assertions.text: The fallback output is a real geometry artifact.
assertions.note: xtbopt.xyz exists in the audit run directory.

assertions.text: The platform limitation is an explicit boundary, not a silent degradation.
assertions.note: SKILL.md tells native-Windows users to use WSL or the documented fallback.

inputs.label: Malformed and empty SMILES plus deterministic seed regression
inputs.execution_note: Tested two syntactically malformed strings and empty string, then compared two identical seeded caffeine runs and a changed seed.
inputs.note: All three invalid inputs raised the same explicit ValueError; same-seed output matched and a different seed changed the result.

assertions.text: Syntactically malformed SMILES fail with an actionable error.
assertions.note: Both malformed strings raised Invalid SMILES ValueError.

assertions.text: Empty SMILES fails through the same public validation contract.
assertions.note: The zero-atom guard raised Invalid SMILES: ''.

assertions.text: Fixed seeds reproduce the sampled result.
assertions.note: Two seed-7 sorted energy lists were identical.

assertions.text: Changing the seed changes the sampled ensemble as expected.
assertions.note: Seed 99 gave a different sorted energy list.

inputs.label: Metal and disconnected-fragment coverage boundary regression
inputs.execution_note: Embedded an Fe-containing disconnected fixture and passed it through parameter selection.
inputs.note: 5 conformers embedded and the installed RDKit reported usable MMFF94s parameters; the Skill remains explicit that this does not validate coordination chemistry.

assertions.text: A metal-containing disconnected input does not cause an unhandled crash.
assertions.note: The workflow embedded and optimized five conformers.

assertions.text: The force-field branch reports its actual selection.
assertions.note: All returned records identified MMFF94s.

assertions.text: The Skill avoids treating generic force fields as coordination validation.
assertions.note: UFF and MMFF caveats explicitly exclude metal-coordination validation.

assertions.text: No unsupported no-force-field claim is invented from this fixture.
assertions.note: The report records the observed MMFF94s result rather than asserting a missing-parameter path.

inputs.label: Empty helper, mismatch, and identical-energy regression
inputs.execution_note: Ran empty and mismatched filter inputs plus empty, non-finite, and identical Boltzmann energy vectors.
inputs.note: Empty energy filtering returns []; mismatches and invalid energy vectors raise clear errors; identical energies produce uniform normalized weights.

assertions.text: Empty aligned energy-filter input is handled gracefully.
assertions.note: filter_by_energy(None, [], []) returned [].

assertions.text: Mismatched conformer and energy arrays are rejected explicitly.
assertions.note: The error names the equal-length contract.

assertions.text: Empty and non-finite Boltzmann inputs are rejected explicitly.
assertions.note: Both cases raised ValueError.

assertions.text: Identical finite energies yield valid normalized uniform weights.
assertions.note: Three weights were one-third and summed to one.

inputs.label: Fresh packaged macrocycle comparison and argument validation
inputs.execution_note: Ran compare_macrocycle_embedding.py on a lactam and tested invalid --n-conf 0.
inputs.note: Both default and explicit opt-out embedded and MMFF-scored 5/5 conformers; invalid count failed clearly.

assertions.text: The packaged comparison script is directly executable.
assertions.note: It emitted parseable JSON.

assertions.text: Both compared macrocycle settings produce traceable counts and energy ranges.
assertions.note: Each path embedded and scored five conformers.

assertions.text: The comparison result is scoped to the tested molecule.
assertions.note: Script and SKILL.md label it a diagnostic rather than a benchmark.

assertions.text: Invalid requested conformer count is rejected clearly.
assertions.note: --n-conf 0 exited nonzero with an at-least-one message.

key_strengths: The exact source commit passed all nine archived logical workflows, including a 45-conformer flexible-drug pipeline and real UFF fallback.
Empty and malformed molecule inputs, empty helper inputs, mismatched data, and non-finite Boltzmann energies now have explicit, actionable handling.
The Windows CREST limitation is accurately bounded and its documented native xTB fallback executed to a real optimized geometry artifact.
The macrocycle discussion now reflects current RDKit defaults and offers a runnable molecule-specific comparison without overstating its result.
Fresh packaged-example checks confirm the shipped Python contracts match the inline workflow.
